reviewed_guarantees: Canonical local identity pin and copied metadata pass through the reviewed three-span reader.
Window and fractional rate come from bound tile metadata, with orientation and scale vector dimensions rechecked.
Stored finite F16 suh/svh are applied exactly once under the pinned folded-scale contract.
Strict element and Hadamard-work caps plus estimated Python-memory budget are enforced before payload read; overrides cannot exceed hard caps.
Post-decode file/stat and implementation guards remain active; nonfinite scales/results and overflow fail closed.
Returned FP16 bits are immutable and receipts are detached copies; forward/transpose are explicitly float64 mathematical references.
numerical_evidence_scope: Independent constant-codeword H128 identity oracles and non-square signed-scale forward/transpose check.
Nonconstant composition equality reuses the existing decoder and is not a second independent decoder.
Window14 evidence is synthetic, not a converter-produced real expert known-answer test.
limits: Actual 2560x640 experts are deliberately above the 65536-element cap.
16MiB Python estimate is not a measured RSS guarantee; raw FP16/F32 byte counts understate Python storage.
Public matrix computation differs from serving transformed-activation FP16 rounding.
No actual-model payload, Metal/GPU, architecture or training qualification.
Local checksum pinning is consistency validation, not authenticated upstream provenance.
